title: Bhagaban Jayasingh
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Bhagaban Jayasingh Biography from 2024 Bhagaban Jayasingh: is an eminent bilingual writer, who has published nine books in Odia, including Sahitya Akademi award winning Ferranti Ghar and about seven in English and English translation. Black Eagle Books has published The Dapples of Darkness, an anthology of his poetry in English and Footprints of Fire, a translation of seventy-four contemporary Odia poets. Recently Central Sahitya Akademi has brought out Sitakant Mahapatra: A Reader, edited by him. His critical work on modern Odia poetry Door to Despair: Modernism in Odia Poetry has been published by Authors Press, New Delhi. Dr Jayasingh has received a flurry of literary awards, including Vishub Jhankar, Jivan Rang, Utkal Sahitya Samaj and Odisha Sahitya Akademi awards for poetry. title: Bina Singh
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Bina Singh Biography from 2024 Prof. Bina Singh born and brought up in Varanasi, obtained her M. A. PhD in English from BHU Varanasi. Prof. Singh, former head of the department of English Vasant Kanya Mahavidyalaya BHU Varanasi. Presently Ms Singh is President of Kashi Tatav Sabha Theosophical Society Indian section Varanasi. Prof. Singh taught English literature and language for 40 years. Her area of interest is American literature, feminist literature Indian literature and other world literature. Dr. Singh has chaired participated and organized various national and international seminars conferences, literary festival and workshops. She has published 8 books, 3 on literature and 5 anthology of poems. Prof. Singh has received many national and international awards and recognition for her service to literature and humanity. Dr. Bina Singh is member of various academic and socio cultural organizations. Dr. Singh is patron of Vaidik foundation Kashi and Ashav, war against cancer. Literature is her passion and poetry first love. She believes that serving the suffering is serving the Supreme. From the 2024 festival Dilip Mohapatra Biography from 2024 Cmde Dilip Mohapatra, VSM (b.1950), a decorated Navy Veteran is a well acclaimed poet in contemporary English and his poems appear in many literary journals of repute and anthologies worldwide. He has six poetry collections, one short story collection and two professional books to his credit so far all published by Authorspress. He is the recipient of the prestigious Honour Award for complete work under Naji Naaman Literary Awards for 2020 and holds the honorary title of ‘Member of Maison Naaman pour la Culture’. He holds two masters degrees: in Physics and Management Studies. He lives with his wife in Pune. His website may be accessed at dilipmohapatra.com . title: Elham Hossain
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Elham Hossain Biography from 2024 Professor Dr. Elham Hossain is an academic, essayist, translator, editor and literary critic. He did his B.A. (Honours) and M.A. in English Literature. He wrote his MPhil dissertation on the colonial literature and Doctoral dissertation on the novels of Chinua Achebe in the University of Dhaka. He has authored twelve books on colonial and postcolonial literature. A huge number of his research articles have been published in the prestigious academic journals of home and abroad. His area of interest encompasses the vast array of South Asian and African literatures and cultures, literary theories, history and anthropology. He edits a periodical Africar Alo (Light of Africa) published from Centre for Studies in African Literatures and Cultures, Dhaka . He is a Professor of English of Dhaka City College, Dhaka, Bangladesh. At the festival Panel Discussion:Non-Fiction: The Current Flavour

title: Gopal Lahiri
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Gopal Lahiri Biography from 2024 Gopal Lahiri is a bilingual poet, critic, editor, writer and translator with 27 books published, (10 books in Bengali and 17 books in English) including five jointly edited books. His poetry and prose are published across various anthologies as well as in eminent journals of India and abroad. His poems are translated in 16 languages. He has been nominated for Pushcart Prize for poetry in 2021. He is the recipient of the Poet of the Year Award in Destiny Poets , UK, 2016, Setu Excellence Award, 2020, Pittsburgh, US and Indology Life-Time Achievement award, West Bengal, India. His latest collection of poems ‘ Alleys are Filled with FuHisture Alphabets.’ has received wide acclaim. He has recently edited an anthology of poems ‘Voices Within’, published by Setu publications, US. His new collection of poems ‘ Crossing the Shoreline’ will be published soon. title: Namitarani Panda
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Namitarani Panda Biography from 2024 Namitarani Panda is a multilingual poet, story writer, editor and translator from Sambalpur, Odisha. She has five anthologies of poems to her credit: Blue Butterflies, Rippling Feelings, A Slice of Sky and A Song for Myself and Colours of Love . She is co-translator of Rivulets of Reflections , a book of translated stories from Odia to English. She has co-authored Radical Rhythm Volume I to IV with the credit of editorship of Radical Rhythm II . She is co-editor of two anthologies of poems Resplendent Rainbow and Durga the Invincible . Her signature words are love, optimism and self-confidence. Presently she is working as Vice Principal of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Cuttack, Odisha. Explore festival appearances across years →

title: Rajorshi Patranabis
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Rajorshi Patranabis Biography from 2024 Rajorshi Patranabis is a multilingual poet, translator and editor delving into myriad forms of poetry. A food consultant, by profession, and a Wiccan, by philosophy, his collections boasts of supernatural and metaphysical love poems( Crossover-love beyond eternity), sonnets(Pregnant), haiku(Solstice ), ghazals in English with a pen name Kafir( Through your Eyes), poems of love in Bengali(Feriwala) and a couple of Assamese translation projects( Nirjon Soikot-Luit Hooghly, Ramp) and quite a few publications in national and international journals and anthologies.His latest collection is Shaktirupen, which is a collection of 30 sonnets about some known and unknown women characters of Ramayan and Mahabharat. His upcoming projects include Palette, which is a collection of haibun and Soliloquy ( his second collection of Ghazals in English) At the festival Moderator · Panel Discussion:Green Literature - The New Paradigm

title: Ranjit Dutta
text: Past festivals / 2024 From the 2024 festival Ranjit Dutta Biography from 2024 Dr Ranjit Dutta M.A,M.Phil,Ph.D , is a bilingual Poet ,Novelist ,Critic , lyricist and Translator and published in Assamese ,English language.He has authored three novels in Assamese namely "Keijonman Bondhu dutiman Golpo Aru Ekhon Upayanakh","Kolahirar Dekholoi" and "Nishter Kothare" ,six volumes of poetry in Assamese such as "Hridoyot Junak", "Kehraj Buliya Anubhob","Kobita Mur Mouna Prohoror","Niribili Nijanote" ,"Hur Eti Diyana" Hunyata Aru Kulaholor Dumujat" and five Translation volumes of world poetry from English to Assamese language such as " Esati Hugodhi Moloya Part -I , Part II and part-III and East Wind and "Flows Like a River" "Peeping through the Windows" from Assamese to English. He has also published another translation works of poetry from Bengali to Assamese and Assamese to English with his co-poet Rajarshi Patranabis of west Bengal entitled "Nirjon Soikot - Luit Hoogli" and "Ramp" respectively.l.Poetry of Dr Dutta is also published a cross various anthologies as well as in various eminent journals of the country.He is the recipient of State and National Awards.He has been associated with various social activities particularly in the field of education and Assamese Poetry.He was also awarded " Somaj Pran "and "Somaj Ratna award" for his brilliant contribution towards the society and also "Anubad Ratna"award for his outstanding contribution in translation of poetry to various languages.He has founded two colleges for the spread of education in the remote place like Ledo of North East Assam and gifted to society. About Us Welcome to the Toshali Literature Festival 2025 The Toshali Literature Festival, hosted in Bhubaneswar, is a vibrant celebration of literature and the arts. With engaging panel discussions, poetry sessions, and cultural events, it brings together authors, thinkers, and creatives from across India. Organized by the Udaygiri Foundation, the festival aims to promote diverse voices, regional literature, and intellectual discourse. It serves as a platform for exploring ideas, storytelling, and the power of words in an evolving cultural landscape.

Organized by the Udaygiri Foundation, the festival aims to promote diverse voices, regional literature, and intellectual discourse. Experience inspiring talks from industry leaders, innovators, and visionaries who will share their expertise, success stories, and practical insights to empower your growth. title: About Us · 2026
text: Past festivals / 2026 Festival record · 2026 About Us Introduction carried in the 2026 archive; original heading refers to 2025. About Us Welcome to the Toshali Literature Festival 2025 The Toshali Literature Festival, hosted in Bhubaneswar, is a vibrant celebration of literature and the arts. With engaging panel discussions, poetry sessions, and cultural events, it brings together authors, thinkers, and creatives from across India. Organized by the Udaygiri Foundation, the festival aims to promote diverse voices, regional literature, and intellectual discourse. It serves as a platform for exploring ideas, storytelling, and the power of words in an evolving cultural landscape.

With engaging panel discussions, poetry sessions, and cultural events, it brings together authors, thinkers, and creatives from across India. Organized by the Udaygiri Foundation, the festival aims to promote diverse voices, regional literature, and intellectual discourse. It serves as a platform for exploring ideas, storytelling, and the power of words in an evolving cultural landscape. Experience inspiring talks from industry leaders, innovators, and visionaries who will share their expertise, success stories, and practical insights to empower your growth. Immerse yourself in a transformative journey filled with impactful sessions, hands-on workshops, and engaging activities that will leave a lasting impression. Connect with like-minded professionals, build valuable relationships, and explore collaborative opportunities that can elevate your career or business. Celebrate with fellow attendees during our vibrant evening events and a relaxed environment perfect for unwinding and connecting. Expand your horizons by meeting diverse individuals from different industries, cultures, and backgrounds, creating opportunities for meaningful interactions.
